channel.title: ProSourced: Blog
channel.description: Practical, evergreen guides on hiring and outsourcing across every business sector: accounting, payroll, HR, consulting, web design, IT, legal and more.

item.title: Employer of record vs PEO vs contractor: how to hire abroad
item.description: Hiring someone in another country? Compare an employer of record, a PEO, contractors and your own entity: how each works, the risks and when each fits.

item.title: Contractor or employee? How the US, UK and EU decide
item.description: How the US, UK and EU decide whether someone is a contractor or an employee: the IRS common-law test, IR35 off-payroll rules and EU platform-work rules.

item.title: The payroll outsourcing checklist: 20 questions to ask providers
item.description: Thinking of outsourcing payroll? Use this checklist to compare providers on compliance, countries covered, security, integrations, service levels and pricing.

item.title: How to choose an accountant for your business, wherever you are
item.description: How to choose a business accountant: the qualifications to check in the US, UK, EU, Canada and Australia, the questions to ask, and how to compare fee quotes.

item.title: How to write a website design brief that gets accurate quotes
item.description: Write a website brief that gets accurate quotes: goals, audience, pages, features, accessibility (WCAG and the European Accessibility Act) and ownership.

item.title: Outsourcing and the GDPR: what every business needs in place
item.description: Outsourcing payroll, HR, IT or marketing? What the GDPR requires: controllers and processors, Article 28 contracts and international data transfers.

item.title: How to hire a management consultant and get real results
item.description: A practical guide to hiring a management consultant: define the problem, choose an independent or a firm, check credentials, agree scope and measure results.

item.title: Cyber security basics for small businesses: a 10-step plan
item.description: Protect your small business with ten practical cyber security steps, based on official guidance from the NCSC (UK), CISA (US) and ENISA (EU). Plain English.

item.title: Translation vs localisation: which does your business need?
item.description: Translation, localisation, transcreation and certified translation explained, with ISO 17100 quality tips and how to brief a translation agency for new markets.

item.title: Fixed fee, hourly or retainer? How professional services are priced
item.description: How professionals price their work: fixed fees, hourly and day rates, retainers and value-based pricing. The pros and cons of each, and how to compare quotes.
